name: transition_to_world_room_event

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_TransitionToWorldRoomEvent consumes four values and passes them in stack order to func_00112848

notes: func_00112848 stores the four values in the engine's requested world, room, event, and spawn-point fields and schedules the full world transition through func_001127E0. ScriptCommand_TransitionToWorldRoomEvent also sets the Script transition-state flag at D_003854E0+0x3070 and returns state 10. The only JP call follows event-camera teardown in pc06.ard and passes (3, 0, 5, 1), selecting Traverse Town world index 3, room index 0 (tw01.ard), event 5, and spawn point 1. This is the Hollow Bastion library sequence associated with young Kairi's conversation with her grandmother during Sora's second Traverse Town visit.
